# Complete Updated Screener Specification

Screen active NIFTY 200 members on the first completed 5-minute candle of each trading day at 09:15 IST. Match only when all of these conditions hold:

- `high(t0) > SMA20(t0)`
- `high(t0) > SMA50(t0)`
- `high(t0) > SMA200(t0)`
- `close(t0) < SMA20(t0)`
- `close(t0) < SMA50(t0)`
- `close(t0) < SMA200(t0)`
- Previous SuperTrend is between the current candle's low and high, inclusive.

Use the selected platform indicator defaults: SMA20 (20), SMA50 (50), SMA200 (200), and SuperTrend (period 10, multiplier 3). If multiple stocks match on a date, return only the stock with the highest liquidity, measured using the last 10 completed daily candles' average volume and relative range. Return one row per matching stock and date, ordered by scan date descending and volume descending.

The default date range is the latest 60 trading sessions. Accept inclusive `from_date` and `to_date` parameters, with a maximum span of 90 calendar days. Support `as_of` replay and comma-separated `symbols` restriction while intersecting requested symbols with the live NIFTY 200 universe. Historical replay must not use candles with an OPEN timestamp later than `as_of`.

Present a ranked table with Symbol, Date, Last price (LTP), Volume, Candle time, Avg volume (20), SMA 20, SMA 50, SMA 200, and SuperTrend. Default to volume descending, 10 results per date, numbered pagination, symbol search, and sortable columns.

Acceptance replays the unchanged fixture at `chart-evidence/31f4a267aa56/acceptance_cases.json` against real candle and indicator history. COLPAL must match the 5-minute candle opened at 2026-10-30 09:15 IST. Record the measured conditions and actual matched rows in `acceptance_report.json`; do not special-case symbols or dates.
